boundary_note: Bounded first pass for the ten frozen records without dossiers in Grant's Operations Against Vicksburg [March-July 1863]; the existing MS009 draft is unchanged. Preserve per-engagement dates. MS011's frozen siege interval (May 18–July 4) contains the separate Milliken's Bend (June 7), Goodrich's Landing (June 29–30) and Helena (July 4) engagements; campaign-wide loss figures must not be assigned to any one engagement. Opening personnel and exact effective command boundaries remain unresolved. Draft claims do not alter model inputs.

claims.rationale: No inspected return establishes matched personnel at a common opening boundary. The frozen side-specific numerical strength bounds are blank (missing_numeric_strength). No figure in this pass is adopted as a simultaneous opening force.

claims.value: The frozen force field names the XVII Army Corps and Gregg's Task Force (equivalent to a brigade) without counts; the live field reads zero. Greene says Gregg's brigade, with State troops, numbered something over 3,000; Gregg reports 2,500 engaged and says the enemy had three divisions in the field, Logan's being chiefly engaged. NPS calls the Union force overwhelming.
claims.rationale: Brigade, engaged and opponent scopes differ; none is adopted as matched opening strength. Live zeros are not measured absence.

claims.value: The frozen casualty text reads 1,011 total (US 442; CS 569); the live field reads 956 total (US 442; CS 514;). Greene gives Logan's loss as 432 plus two in Crocker's division, and Gregg's as 73 killed, 229 wounded and 204 missing, 505 in all; Gregg's report prints 201 missing. Gregg says escaped prisoners put the Union loss at 150 killed and 400 wounded.
claims.rationale: Original casualty returns were not inspected; preserve totals, categories, cutoffs and differences. No canonical reconciliation or casualty-based opening count; related actions must not be added without resolving population overlap. Three Confederate totals (569, 514, 505) and two missing counts (204, 201) differ.

open_questions: McPherson's, Logan's and Crocker's reports and the compiled Confederate return remain deferred.

NPS/CWSAC is one family. Greene is one retrospective history by a non-participant, founded on the Official Records. Each report author selected from Official Records Volumes XXIV and XXII is a separate family of interested accounts; the volumes are shared containers, not additional witnesses, and letters or telegrams by others quoted inside a selected document are not separate families. Report dates are not event times or proof of contemporary knowledge.
No automatic commander attribution, causal campaign score, morale/readiness number or battle/campaign double counting.
